## 5fbb6efffb19

**Reproduced exact-control defect: advertised `wire_shape` is never consumed by production generation.** Assigned generator SHA-256 is `fec645d1e5c9ba853d4914143a678049e77f6d7b6d090bbe18bd214feb8517d6`; canonical rule hash is `70de2799de0a`.

Using audit seed `680d214d64458d4ad3efebcc937049db4423b67bb4a2d8ecb4d002ee01ed66a5`, sample indices 0–29, and each of easy/medium/hard, I generated each point under all five advertised values `wire_shape=0..4`. All five inputs were identical at **90/90 sample points**; equivalently, **900/900 pairwise comparisons** were equal. Every generated grid passed `self_check`. The source advertises the old five-shape bank but now grows a random wire through `_grow_wire` without drawing or reading `wire_shape`.

The retained medium/index-0 counterexample has the same SHA-256 under all five overrides and a selected wire length of 12. Canonical Racket returns a 1×12 strip of color 6. `checks/audit/5fbb6efffb19/counterexample.json` contains the input, all exact override metadata, rule/generator hashes, canonical output, command, and working directory; `checks/audit/5fbb6efffb19/wire_shape_inputs.json` records all five identical generated inputs. This is a generator-control defect rather than a competing solver-rule counterexample.

No fix was made because this is an audit-only target.
